description: A visit to the game website; carries the UTM tags of the landing link
trigger: Each page load (automatic in web analytics SDKs)

description: A visit to the Steam or itch.io page from a tagged link
trigger: Counted by Steam UTM Analytics or the store dashboard

description: The player clicks a wishlist or store button
trigger: On click of a store button on the site or in the game

description: The visitor clicks a demo download or play button on the site
trigger: On click of the demo button

description: The game starts; the first one is the install
trigger: Each launch (automatic in the Manalens game SDKs)
Launch or return after 30 minutes idle (automatic)

description: The player finishes one tutorial step
trigger: When each tutorial step is done
When the last tutorial step is done or the tutorial is skipped

description: The player starts a level or a run
trigger: When the level is loaded and playable

description: The player completes a level or a run
trigger: On the win or exit screen

description: The player fails a level or dies
trigger: On the fail or death screen

description: The player uses a key feature for the first time in a session
trigger: First use per session of a feature you want to measure

description: The player changes a setting that hints at a problem
trigger: On apply in the options menu (graphics quality; difficulty; subtitles; text size; controls)

description: The game opens the website with the identity handoff link
trigger: When a link to the site is opened from the game

description: The website joins a visitor to the game install that opened it
trigger: Page load with mana_hid in the URL (automatic in the Manalens web SDK)
Engine errors (automatic) or a track_error call

description: A real-money purchase in the game or on your own site
trigger: After the store confirms the payment
